name: Gourmethotel Unterwirt
beschreibung:
Situated in the village of Ebbs, Gourmethotel Unterwirt is a premier destination for epicureans and travellers seeking pure relaxation. Elegant guestrooms, a serene spa oasis, and celebrated regional culinary creations ensure a memorable stay.

The Fohlenhof Ebbs stud farm, the Zahmer Kaiser peaks, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gourmethotel Unterwirt in Ebbs dazzles with award-winning fine dining, spa wellness, and stylish accommodation.
